title: RAG demo with real embeddings from Ollama
description: This example builds a small RAG pipeline: it embeds a corpus with Ollama, retrieves the closest passages for a question, and formats a prompt for an LLM to answer using only those passages.

steps.description: The corpus is four markdown files about a bike co-op: hours, membership, tools, and safety. Each file's text is a single string.
The embed function sends texts to Ollama's /api/embed endpoint and returns the embedding vectors. It uses nomic-embed-text:v1.5.
cosine computes cosine similarity between two vectors using the standard formula.
CHUNKS splits each corpus file into paragraphs (separated by blank lines) and tags each with an id, source file, and text. VECTORS embeds all chunk texts at startup.
Each chunk becomes a tuple: chunk id, source filename, and the paragraph text. VECTORS holds the embedding for every chunk.
search embeds the question, computes cosine similarity against every chunk vector, sorts by score descending, and returns the top k.

steps.question: What does the main block print when run with a question?
steps.answer: It prints a prompt for an LLM that includes the top retrieved passages and instructions to answer using only those passages, naming the source file for each fact.

steps.description: The main block reads the question from argv, runs search, prints the scored chunks to stderr, builds a context string from the top hits, and prints the full prompt with instructions.
search returns the top 3 chunks for 'Who do I tell if I get hurt?'. The injury passage from safety.md ranks first with a score around 0.625.
The prompt is printed with the retrieved passages: the injury passage, the safety glasses passage, and the hours passage, followed by the question.
